frames.subject: The white robotaxi seen low from its rear quarter at a night departures curb. The roof dome stands against the terminal's dim, mullioned glass wall. Seven banded steel bollards run back along the island to the left, and the car is cropped by the right edge.
frames.visual_consequence: The car fills the lower right, about 1100 of 1600 px wide at display, with a red tail lamp as its brightest saturated point and a soft contact shadow on the drive lane. The darkened canopy and terminal give the type a true-black field, and the bollard line pulls the eye back into the dark. It reads as a bold single subject at 432 px.
frames.weakness: The car's body is boxy with drawn panel seams and little surface modelling on the flank. The lower-left quadrant of drive lane (display x0 to 500, y1500 to 2000) is eventless asphalt.
frames.repair: Lay the canopy downlight's pool and a faint reflection of the bollard bands onto the wet lane in the lower left, so the foreground carries an event.

frames.subject: A field of 233 banded steel bollards in nine month rows on a near-black apron, seen from high and back. One post carries a comal ring at April 20th, the posts after it are banded and lit in a pool, and the white robotaxi is parked at the end of the October row. Mono labels name February, April 20th, May 1st and October 14th.
frames.visual_consequence: It shows a measured span, 177 days from the creek to the opening, as a countable lit field, with the dark unbanded back rows before April 20th against the lit rows after it. The car gives the posts their scale and ties the count to the deck's hero.
frames.weakness: The posts read as simple capsules. 'February' floats out at the right, loosely tied to the short back row. The comal mark is a dashed ground ellipse, which reads as graphic overlay more than a band on the post itself.
frames.repair: Put the comal on the April 20th post's own reflective band (an emissive band ring on the post) and drop the dashed ground ellipse.

frames.subject: The departures island seen from high at the canopy edge. A long diagonal of banded bollards runs from the lower left away along the island, the white robotaxi waits at the curb from its rear three-quarter, and a traveller steps off the curb toward it under a downlight pool. The terminal's dark glass is on the left and a canopy column is behind the car. The canopy fascia and terminal head band are now near black.
frames.visual_consequence: The strongest image in the deck: one lit subject group in a pool, true blacks in the soffit and lane, crisp cast shadows of bollards and traveller, and the bollard line as a leading diagonal. With the lit diagonal gone, the three-line hook and the dek sit on an unbroken dark field. It returns to the cover's curb from a new camera, so the deck closes where it opened.
frames.weakness: The canopy column stands directly behind the car's dome and merges with it. The shadowed island floor to the left of the traveller carries a navy cast that edges toward a second blue beside the comal accent.
frames.repair: Slide the camera about a metre along the island so the column clears the dome and the dome reads against the lit island floor.
